set.st: Ed Harris tearing down a shed found his miser grandfather's tin box with $1,100 in gold and currency; earlier searches had failed and more was believed hidden. Pin is the old Sturgis farm on the 1872 plat, not the spot itself. Independent listing: Big Beaver (MI gazetteer 1881: village, 31 listings). This confirms the place existed; the pin position still comes from the earlier source. The hider was his grandfather Benjamin Sturgis, a reputed miser (d. c.1879) who 'buried and hid money about the place'; other heirs claimed the box and 'a more thorough search of the old homestead' was promised. No later find reported.
set.pl: Benjamin Sturgis farm (1872 plat), SE sec 22 T2N R11E, Troy Twp, NW of the Big Beaver corner; the grandson's 1908 strip in sec 23 (42.567,-83.120) is the alternative
pinev: 1880 census: Benjamin Sturgis, b. 1809, Troy Twp. 1872 Oakland Co plat: 'B. Sturgis 120', SE part of sec 22 T2N R11E, NW of the Big Beaver corner; a C. Harris 40 at the sec 21/22 line.
1908 plat: Chas. Sturgis dairy farm NW sec 22; a 'Harris 15' strip in sec 23 centre-S (42.567,-83.120), the alternative site for the shed torn down in 1909.
Now Troy suburbs: built over, look only.
